note: Content API (lightning_api) glues core JSON:API + optional Simple OAuth + OpenAPI for decoupled Drupal. Its own config is lightning_api.settings with two booleans: entity_json ('View JSON' entity operation link -> the entity's JSON:API URL) and bundle_docs ('View API Documentation' bundle operation link), both default false. Settings form /admin/config/system/lightning/api (route lightning_api.settings, permission 'administer site configuration'). A second form /admin/config/system/lightning/api/keys (route lightning_api.generate_keys, permission 'administer simple_oauth entities', requires simple_oauth) generates an OAuth2 key pair and writes paths into simple_oauth.settings. Depends on jsonapi + path_alias. OAuth key generation is intentionally NOT used as an eval (it writes secret files and mutates another module's config, simple_oauth.settings); all cases stay within lightning_api.settings. Medium cases enable a toggle and read it back; hard cases enable a toggle verified against live config. reset/cleanup restore both toggles to false.

evals.prompt: The Drupal lightning_api (Content API) module builds a content API on top of which two web standards / contrib modules for serialization and authentication?
evals.expected_output: It builds on JSON:API (core jsonapi module) for serialization and OAuth2 (the Simple OAuth module) for authentication/authorization; it depends on jsonapi (and path_alias) and optionally integrates simple_oauth and OpenAPI.

evals.prompt: What are the two boolean settings in lightning_api.settings and what does each expose in entity/bundle operations?
evals.expected_output: entity_json adds a 'View JSON' operation link on content entities (to the entity's JSON:API URL); bundle_docs adds a 'View API Documentation' operation link on bundle entities. Both default to false in lightning_api.settings.

evals.prompt: Does lightning_api help generate OAuth keys? If so, at what admin path, which permission is required, and which module must be installed?
evals.expected_output: Yes: the OAuth key form is at /admin/config/system/lightning/api/keys (route lightning_api.generate_keys), requires the 'administer simple_oauth entities' permission, and is only available when the simple_oauth module is installed. It generates a key pair and stores the paths in simple_oauth.settings.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, inspect the Content API (lightning_api) configuration and state whether the 'View JSON' entity operation link is currently enabled.
evals.expected_output: Yes — lightning_api.settings entity_json is true (the 'View JSON' link is enabled). Read via `drush cget lightning_api.settings entity_json`.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, inspect the Content API (lightning_api) configuration and state whether the 'View API Documentation' bundle operation link is currently enabled.
evals.expected_output: Yes — lightning_api.settings bundle_docs is true (the 'View API Documentation' link is enabled). Read via `drush cget lightning_api.settings bundle_docs`.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, configure the Content API (lightning_api) module to expose the 'View JSON' link in entity operations. Apply the change to the live site's configuration.
evals.expected_output: Set lightning_api.settings entity_json to true, e.g. `drush cset lightning_api.settings entity_json 1 -y` or via the form at /admin/config/system/lightning/api. Verified: entity_json === TRUE.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, configure the Content API (lightning_api) module to expose the 'View API Documentation' link in bundle (content type) operations. Apply the change to the live site's configuration.
evals.expected_output: Set lightning_api.settings bundle_docs to true, e.g. `drush cset lightning_api.settings bundle_docs 1 -y` or via the form at /admin/config/system/lightning/api. Verified: bundle_docs === TRUE.
